original: 暑い日は冷たいビールに限る。

en.text: There is nothing like cold beer on a hot day.
There is nothing more refreshing than a cold beer on a hot day.
On a hot day, nothing is better than a cold beer.

original: 英作文の上達には英語で日記を付けるに限る。

en.text: The best way to master English composition is to keep a diary in English.

en.text: When it's hot, there's nothing like a cold beer.
